data.one_liner: A step-by-step wizard to introduce products or demonstrate application usage.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget-based step-by-step wizard to highlight target widgets, display customizable introductory cards, and manage demo flows across pages or dialogs.
use_when: You want to build an onboarding tour or product walkthrough for your Flutter app.
You need to highlight specific target widgets and show explanatory cards during a user walkthrough.
avoid_when: You need complex state management or dependency injection unrelated to UI onboarding walkthroughs.
strengths: Automatically calculates target widget location and intro card alignment.
Supports nested demo flows and linking between different pages or dialogs.
Customizable style, behavior, cards, and highlighted decorations.
weaknesses: Limited to guided wizard and tutorial overlays.
Requires manual step setup and wrapping targets with IntroStepTarget.
